videos.title: Scientists Found a Miniature Stonehenge in the Amazon — But WHO Built It?!
videos.description:
In 2013, researchers in Peru discovered a tiny silk structure that looks exactly like Stonehenge — only 2 cm wide. The strangest part? No one has ever seen its builder. Nature's strangest mystery!
